notes: v52 = DelphiUnicode qualified System.PChar/PPChar/PPPChar aliases now resolve to PWideChar/PPWideChar/PPPWideChar (parser pbase.pas + compile-time {$if} scanner.pas paths), matching the implicit uachar/uuchar unqualified aliases; previously a qualified System.PChar resolved to the ANSI 1-byte declaration. Also fixes the fcl-db MySQL connector: FIELD_TYPE_NULL -> ftVariant, and a new PreserveEmbeddedNullText property maps embedded-NUL text columns to ftMemo instead of a NUL-truncated ftString. Atop v51 non-ASCII multiline-string ICE fix + v50 -Munleashed string-const overload fix + v49 SizeOf/High(Char) delphiunicode preproc fix + v48 string/char Delphi parity. Compiler-only binary refresh; drops on the v48 unit set. A separate mysqlconn overlay carries the rebuilt connector units for DB consumers.
